common.notification_message_heating_stopped: Heating permission was disabled because demand ended.
common.notification_message_heat_demand_cancell: The pending heat demand cleared before heating permission was enabled.
common.notification_message_source_state_correc: Controlel detected an unexpected source state and restored the requested state.
common.notification_message_source_correction_f: Controlel could not restore the requested source state.
common.notification_message_source_command_fail: Controlel could not complete the requested heat-source command.
common.notification_message_measurement_degrade: A required temperature measurement became unavailable or stale.
common.notification_message_measurement_recover: The affected temperature measurement is available again.
common.notification_message_safety_fallback_app: Controlel applied a safe fallback because required measurement data was unavailable.

user.title: Add Controlel
user.description: {configure_explanation} Continue to create an empty canonical-v3 installation and open Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Controlel installation is supported.

water_safety_area_sensor.title: Water Safety — Area & moisture sensor
water_safety_area_sensor.description: Area and moisture sensor may be saved separately in an incomplete draft; both are required for activation. Compatible candidates currently show {candidate_scope} ({candidate_count}). Saving updates only the inactive Water draft. Configured selections not present in current discovery: {unavailable_area_sensor}.

water_safety_notifications.title: Water Safety — Notifications
water_safety_notifications.description: {notification_behavior} Saving updates only the inactive Water draft. Configured targets not present in current discovery: {unavailable_notification_targets}. {notification_test_result}

water_safety_sirens.title: Water Safety — Sirens
water_safety_sirens.description: {siren_behavior} Saving updates only the inactive Water draft. Configured targets not present in current compatible discovery: {unavailable_sirens}.

water_safety_shutoff_valves.title: Water Safety — Automatic water shutoff
water_safety_shutoff_valves.description: {shutoff_valve_behavior} Saving updates only the inactive Water draft. Configured targets not present in current compatible discovery: {unavailable_shutoff_valves}.

water_safety_activate.title: Water Safety — Activate configuration
water_safety_activate.description: Activate canonical Water Safety revision {revision_id}? This changes active authority and reloads Controlel. The saved draft is removed only after activation succeeds.

general_hub.title: General — Shared settings
general_hub.description: {general_summary} This page is intentionally small: there are no shared values to save, edit, or clear, and General is never required before configuring a module.

start_greenfield.title: Start Heating configuration
start_greenfield.description: Choose the minimum zone, temperature-sensor and heat-source command bindings needed to create a durable inactive Heating draft. Optional Heating sections can be configured later. Nothing is activated here.

convert_legacy.title: Convert legacy configuration
convert_legacy.description: Explicitly project legacy settings through v2 into a durable v3 review draft. Legacy remains active and unchanged until explicit activation.

convert_v2.title: Convert canonical v2 configuration
convert_v2.description: Explicitly create an inactive canonical v3 review draft from the active v2 revision.

abandon_draft.title: Abandon durable draft
abandon_draft.description: This deletes only editable draft state.

abandon_current.title: Abandon this draft
abandon_current.description: Delete this durable draft without changing canonical or active authority?

zone.title: Heating — Zone & demand
zone.description: Saving updates only this section of the inactive Heating draft and returns to Heating. Area and floor are optional.

sensor.title: Heating — Temperature sensor
sensor.description: Saving updates only this section of the inactive Heating draft. A previously configured entity remains shown if it is currently missing or unavailable; it is never silently removed.

heat_source.title: Heating — Heat source commands
heat_source.description: Commands request heat-source permission; they do not prove physical burner operation. Saving updates only this draft section. Previously configured missing or unavailable entities remain visible and are never silently removed.

heat_delivery.title: Heating — Heat delivery
heat_delivery.description: Heat delivery is optional. Keep Unmanaged when Controlel should not command a room actuator. Clearing the actuator does not change other Heating sections.

safety_timing.title: Heating — Safety & timing
safety_timing.description: These values are seconds unless stated otherwise. Saving changes only the inactive Heating draft; active protection remains unchanged until activation.

diagnostics.title: Heating — Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Heating diagnostic preferences are optional and saved independently in the inactive draft.

notifications.title: Heating — Notifications
notifications.description: Heating notifications are optional. Recipient IDs remain stable and are managed by Controlel; clearing recipients does not modify other Heating settings.

heating_review.title: Heating — Review & activate
heating_review.description: {heating_review_summary} Continue only when activation-ready. Continuing creates an immutable candidate; activation remains a separate explicit confirmation.

save_draft.title: Save draft
save_draft.description: Save these edits as a new durable draft revision? Saving does not validate, canonicalize, or activate.

draft_saved.title: Draft saved
draft_saved.description: Draft {draft_id} is durable and inactive. Choose a separate next action.

validate.title: Validate draft
validate.description: Validate the saved draft against a fresh Home Assistant discovery snapshot? Validation does not activate.

canonicalize.title: Create canonical revision
canonicalize.description: Create an immutable canonical revision from this validated draft? This still does not activate it.

activate.title: Activate canonical revision
activate.description: Explicitly activate revision {revision_id}? This is the authority transition and reloads Controlel.

error.invalid_water_area_sensor: The Water area or moisture sensor selection is no longer valid. Review the current Home Assistant entities and try again.
error.invalid_water_notification_targets: One or more notification targets are invalid or unavailable. Review the current Home Assistant notify services and try again.
error.invalid_water_siren_targets: One or more siren targets are incompatible or no longer registered. Select compatible Home Assistant siren entities and try again.
error.invalid_water_shutoff_valve_targets: One or more shutoff valve targets are incompatible or no longer registered. Select water-class Home Assistant valve entities that support closing and try again.
error.water_safety_validation_failed: The Water Safety draft is not activation-ready. Complete the required sections and review it again.
error.water_safety_activation_failed: Water Safety could not be activated safely. The saved draft and previous active configuration were retained.
error.heating_activation_failed: Heating could not be activated safely. The saved draft and all previous active module configurations were retained.
error.validation_failed: The draft is not activation-ready. Correct the reported issues and validate again.

abort.canonical_legacy_mixed: This entry contains both canonical and legacy authority. Resolve the mixed entry before configuring it.
abort.draft_abandoned: The durable draft was abandoned. Active authority was not changed.
abort.conversion_not_ready: Conversion requires reference review before editing can continue.
